Services.title: Our Services
Services.description:
We define the structure of your work as an ontology, then let agents work on top of it.
UpServe is where our focus is today.

upserve.title: UpServe
upserve.tagline: Agents that know your work, doing it for you
upserve.description:
An ontology-driven agent platform.
Repetitive work — catalog upkeep, booking replies, order intake, document checks — is handled by agents that understand how your business is structured.

features.title: Grounded in an ontology
features.description: We first define the concepts and relationships your work runs on — products, orders, customers. Agents act with that context, so the results hold up.

features.title: Approval before action
features.description: Hard-to-undo actions like payments or public posting always wait for your approval.

features.title: Autonomous scheduling
features.description: A plain instruction creates a recurring schedule, and results arrive as push notifications.

features.title: Works with your tools
features.description: Connects to 18+ services including SmartStore, Naver Booking, Ecount ERP, Slack, and GitHub.

features.title: Runs in the cloud
features.description: Operates in an isolated cloud sandbox — manage it from a browser or the app, no hardware required.

features.title: Build it, or hand it over
features.description: Start free with no card required and build it yourself. Short on time? We take it from setup through day-to-day operation.
